Bina tel ke taiyar hone vala chaval ke bajay suji se bani yah bangali-odishi dish sardiyon ki subah ke lie parphekt hai. kek jaisa naram aur phula huaa, How to Make Bhapa Pitha at Home- nariyal aur gur se bhara huaa paranprik bhapa pitha. janen ise stim karke ekdam sopht aur parphekt teksachar men taiyar karne ki step-bay-step vidhi, bachchon aur pure parivar ke lie parphekt
Ingredients for Bhapa Peetha
Suji - Semolina - 1 cup (180g)
Chini - Sugar - 2 tbsp
Dudh - Milk - 1 cup
Nariyal - Fresh Coconut - 1 no.
Gur - Jaggery - ½ cup (75g)
Ilaychi paudar - Cardamom Powder - ½ tsp
